Exit polls show Mamdani won with 50% of the vote, while Cuomo received 19% and Sliwa 5%. The question asks if Mamdani will win second place, which directly contradicts the actual election outcome where he finished first. Since the election has already occurred and results are documented, the probability that Mamdani finished in second place is effectively zero.
